title: Snapshot array
statementMd:
An array of `length` zeros. `['set', i, v]` sets an element, `['snap']` takes a snapshot and returns its id (0, 1, ...), `['get', i, id]` returns the element's value at that snapshot. Return the results of snap and get.

**Example:** `snapshot_array(3, [["set", 0, 5], ["snap"], ["set", 0, 6], ["get", 0, 0], ["s…)` returns `[0, 5, 1, 6]`.
hints: Store (snapshot id, value) history per index and binary search.
